report:
Breast, right, wide local excision

The specimen consists of a right wide local excision specimen (60 g, 70 x 55 x 30 mm). Sectioning reveals a firm, tan, ill-defined, stellate tumour measuring 8 mm in greatest dimension (8 x 6 x 5 mm) in the upper inner quadrant (1 o'clock), 6 mm from the anterior margin. A clip is present within the tumour bed. Three lymph nodes are identified in the sentinel node specimen.

(1-8) tumour bed with the anterior margin.
(9-13) posterior, superior, inferior, medial and lateral margins.
(14-15) sentinel lymph nodes (3 nodes).

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision (less than total mastectomy)
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour site: Upper inner quadrant (1 o'clock)
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 8 mm (8 x 6 x 5 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (ductal)
- Tumour focality: Single focus of invasive carcinoma
- Histologic grade: Grade 3 (scores of 8 or 9); total score 8
- Tubule formation: Score 3
- Nuclear pleomorphism: Score 3
- Mitotic rate: Score 2
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an invasive carcinoma of no special type, Nottingham grade 3 (tubule formation 3, nuclear pleomorphism 3, mitotic count 2; total 8), measuring 8 mm in greatest dimension. The tumour infiltrates as solid nests, sheets and cords of cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, pleomorphic vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, within a desmoplastic stroma. There is a response to presurgical therapy (Miller-Payne grade 3). Ductal carcinoma in situ of high nuclear grade, solid and comedo types, with comedo necrosis, is present (12 mm). There is no lymphovascular invasion.
- Tumour extension: Confined to the breast parenchyma
  - Nipple: Not present in specimen
  - Skin: Not present in specimen
  - Skin satellite foci: Not identified
  - Skeletal muscle: Not present in specimen
- Lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Dermal lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not applicable (no skin present)
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Breast treatment effect: Probable or definite response to presurgical therapy
  in the invasive carcinoma
- LN treatment effect: No lymph node metastases. Fibrous scarring or histiocytic
  aggregates, possibly related to prior lymph node metastases with pathologic
  complete response
- Grading of treatment effects (Miller and Payne): Grade 3
- Ductal carcinoma in situ: Present, Negative for extensive intraductal
  component (EIC)
  - Size (extent) of DCIS: 12 mm
  - Number of blocks with DCIS: 4 of 15 blocks examined
  - Nuclear grade: Grade III (high)
  - Necrosis: Present, central (expansive "comedo" necrosis)
  - Architectural patterns: Solid, Comedo
- Additional lesions: Not identified
- Microcalcifications: Present in DCIS

Ancillary studies
- Biomarker studies: Reported on the prior core biopsy (S26-00789): ER negative,
  PR negative, HER2 positive (score 3+), Ki-67 60%

- Anterior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
  than 10 mm
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater

- Superior margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, closest distance: greater
